info.title: Lifecare FamilyCare (FC) API — caremanagement subset
info.description: Trimmed subset of Tieto/Lifecare FamilyCare API V1 used by api-service-caremanagement: EB write-back (aktualisering + normberäkning) + proposal lookups, and the person-based case-data reads (persons, contacts, actualisations, calculations, decisions, payments, investigations, services, executions, resource allocations, documents) and document content. Full spec archived in vof-ekonomiskt-bistand/docs/source/lifecare-fc-swagger-v1.json. Auth (domain+key query params / X-API-Key header) is applied by LifecareFcConfiguration, not modelled here.

Id.description: FC user id (max length 10). Used as the actualisation CaseworkerId.

NetworkUserId.description: Network (AD) user id — used as the careM errand assignedUserId.

FullName.description: Full display name — matched against the Service's Caseworker.
